text: Hello, it's Maureen Daly at High Street, Wenlow. I've had the back-dated bill for $640 come through and I want to pay it, but this week it lands the same time as the mortgage and I can't do both without bouncing. Could we agree a short repayment plan — say half this week and the rest over the next few weeks? I'd rather sort it with you than miss it. Thanks.
reply: Hello Maureen, thank you for getting in touch before the payment became overdue, it's much appreciated. We're happy to set up a repayment plan for the $640 back-dated amount. Because it's currently due and not overdue, we've agreed to spread it into equal weekly instalments over 8 weeks, paid alongside your regular $48 Wednesday energy bill. Your account will show the plan once it's confirmed. If the weekly amount becomes difficult at any point, please contact us straight away so we can look at alternatives. Kind regards, Northgrid Energy Customer Desk.

text: Hi, Alan Daly from Wenlow Bakery & Deli. Could you confirm availability and earliest delivery today for up to 650 units at $6.54 each? I need a firm answer on quantity and delivery time. Thanks.
reply:
Dear Alan,

Thank you for your letter. I can confirm the current price for your account is $6.54 per unit. However, I do not have availability or stock figures for the 650 units in front of me, so I cannot give you a firm quantity confirmation from this desk, and I am not able to promise an earliest delivery time today. There is currently no order on your account for Monday and no delivery recorded for this week.

If you would like to go ahead, please place the order through the usual channel so it can be checked against stock and scheduled. Once it is placed, the warehouse team can confirm the quantity available and the delivery slot. If you need a firm answer urgently, please call the sales desk directly and ask for the warehouse to check stock for your 650 units before you commit.

Kind regards,
Brook Cash & Carry Sales Desk

text: Hello, sorry to chase first thing — we only received 14 of the 652 units ordered for delivery today. We urgently need the remaining 638. Can you confirm when they can arrive, and whether any can come today? This is a serious problem for us. Thanks, Alan
reply:
Dear Alan,

Thank you for your letter, and I'm sorry for the short delivery. Your account shows that the order of 652 units was delivered as only 14, so 638 units are outstanding. There is currently no order on the books for Monday, and I can't see a confirmed delivery date for the missing units in your account, so I'm not able to confirm an arrival time from here. I have flagged the shortfall for the team to investigate and to arrange the remaining 638 units as urgently as possible, and I will ask them to contact you directly with a firm delivery time and to say whether any can come today. Your current price remains $7.03 per unit.

If you need to be in touch sooner, please call the sales desk and quote your account reference.

Kind regards,
Sales Desk, Dales Wholesale

text: Hello, thanks for your note. I’m sorry too — that short delivery has left me badly exposed. Please confirm today whether the 638 outstanding units can arrive before Monday, and give me a firm delivery time. If you cannot guarantee it, please say so clearly so I can order elsewhere. Many thanks, Alan Daly, Wenlow Bakery & Deli.
reply:
Dear Alan,

Thank you for your letter, and I apologise for the short delivery. Your last order was for 652 units, of which only 14 were delivered, leaving 638 outstanding.

I cannot confirm from the account that the 638 outstanding units will arrive before Monday, and I do not have a firm delivery time to give you. I would rather be clear about that than promise something I cannot guarantee. Please treat that as a clear answer: I am not able to guarantee the 638 units by Monday, so you may wish to source them elsewhere in the meantime.

Your Monday order is for 652 units at $7.03 per unit. I will pass your request for a firm delivery date for the outstanding units to our dispatch team today, and we will confirm the timing to you as soon as we have it.

Kind regards,
Dales Wholesale Sales Desk

text: Hello, sorry to trouble you. Can you confirm the outstanding order position for Monday and whether the 652-unit Dales order can be reduced or delayed given cash flow? Please also confirm any short deliveries on recent orders. Thank you.
reply:
Dear Alan,

Thank you for your letter. Here is the position on your account:

Outstanding order for Monday: 652 units at $7.20 per unit, a total of $4,694.40.

Short delivery: the most recent order of 652 units was short-delivered, with only 14 units received, so 638 units are outstanding against that order. The two earlier orders of 577 and 652 units were delivered in full.

On reducing or delaying the Monday order: I am not able to change an order myself, as orders are placed by the shop. I can pass your request to our sales team, who can discuss options such as a reduced quantity or a later delivery date with you. Please call or reply to confirm which you would like me to forward.

With regards,
Dales Wholesale Sales Desk
